design.execution_note: recognition audit only; DDV20 and portfolio execution are deferred until a ranker survives holdout
design.winner_selection: DEV 2016-2020 only; lexicographic: annual Top5 Top5 within30, within50, rolling Top10 Top5 within30, within50, annual capture, lower median gain
design.holdout: 2024-2026 untouched; annual labels use complete years only, rolling labels may include 2026 if 126d outcome exists
design.market_gate: ignored in recognition audit because prior audit showed it delays leader capture
design.taxonomy_caveat: Sector/Industry and Theme membership use current repository taxonomy; any surviving context rule requires a later PIT-taxonomy audit before adoption
design.volume_contraction: prior-day mean volume10 / prior-day mean volume20; lower ratio receives higher cross-sectional percentile
design.context_score: group 63d RS percentile + 20d RS-rank acceleration percentile + group EMA21 breadth percentile, equal-weighted
